title: P1 — full test suite hangs indefinitely when the network is cut (dead proxy)
fix: tests/net-guard.ts (new): TCP-probes each configured proxy (HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY/ALL_PROXY, both spellings) with a 2s hard budget, honours NO_PROXY, throws NETWORK-UNREACHABLE naming the endpoint; SPECLANG_SKIP_NET_GUARD=1 escape hatch.
tests/setup-tmpdir.ts: awaits the preflight in the setupFiles seam so the failure is COUNTED in the vitest summary (Test Files N failed) instead of an uncounted global-setup crash.
vitest.config.ts: testTimeout 30s / hookTimeout 30s / teardownTimeout 20s (per-test overrides still win).
tests/net-guard.test.ts (new, 27 hermetic cases) + doc pointer in tests/global-setup.ts.

ac1_dead_proxy.result: RC=1 WALL=4s; 'Test Files 110 failed (110)'; 'NETWORK-UNREACHABLE: a proxy is configured but nothing answered it' at tests/net-guard.ts:234 via tests/setup-tmpdir.ts:29

gitreins.tier2: PASS — judge independently re-ran AC1 twice (EXIT=1 in 4.0s and 7.0s), guard.test.ts 36/36, net-guard 27/27, and confirmed NO_PROXY + SKIP_NET_GUARD + blackholed-proxy arms

residual_risk_named_by_judge_and_worker: Untimed execSync/spawnSync sites (59 in tests/) can still block the event loop when the hang is NOT a configured-and-unreachable proxy (DNS blackhole with no proxy env, stuck git on a hung mount); the preflight only covers the proxy-configured case and vitest's testTimeout cannot fire while the event loop is blocked.

Any unreachable proxy now fails the whole 110-file run even for tests that never touch the network; a developer behind a temporarily-down corporate proxy gets a total red run. Mitigation: NO_PROXY / SPECLANG_SKIP_NET_GUARD=1, both proven.
